column1: # ADR-0034 D2 — the reserved-domain rule's shared case table (R3#5 / R4#2).
# `input` is a bare domain (an EXPECTED_EMAIL_DOMAIN, or the domain part of an
# ADMIN_EMAILS element); `expect` is OK when it is a plausible ASCII domain whose
# LAST label is a reserved name (local / test / invalid / example / localhost),
# Platform shell: scripts/lib/roster.sh roster_domain_reserved. Same file format
# as cases.tsv (see its header): split on the first tab, `#` and blank lines
# --- OK: the last label is reserved, compared exactly
# --- REJECT: a label that merely resembles a reserved one
